title: LLM-Based Generative Retrieval for Snapchat Content Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2607.28895v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Pretrained large language models (LLMs) are promising retrieval engines because they combine rich semantic priors, strong sequence modeling capabilities, and favorable scaling behavior. However, turning a pretrained LLM into a generative retriever in production deployment raises several challenges: the model must learn an internal item vocabulary that was absent from pretraining, and generate valid item identifiers under strict latency and cost constraints. We address these challenges through the design and launch of SnapLGR, an LLM-based generative retrieval system for short-video recommendation at Snapchat. The system is built around three main designs. translated_abstract: 预训练的大语言模型（LLMs）因其丰富的语义先验、强大的序列建模能力和良好的扩展性，被视为有前景的检索引擎。然而，在生产部署中将预训练LLM转化为生成式检索器面临若干挑战：模型必须学习预训练中不存在的内部物品词汇表，并在严格的延迟和成本约束下生成有效的物品标识符。我们通过设计和推出SnapLGR来应对这些挑战，这是一个用于Snapchat短视频推荐的基于LLM的生成式检索系统。该系统围绕三个主要设计构建。首先，我们从多模态物品嵌入构建语义标识符（SIDs），并通过基于个性化PageRank（PPR）的共参与对比学习增强它们，从而改善码本利用率、减少冲突并注入协同信号。其次，我们使用...
tldr: 本文提出SnapLGR，一个基于LLM的生成式检索系统，通过语义标识符和对比学习优化，解决了生产环境中短视频推荐的高效检索问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SnapLGR, an LLM-based generative retrieval system that leverages semantic identifiers and contrastive learning to address efficient retrieval challenges in production short-video recommendation.
